currentCoordinate.coordNote: Legacy point retained as a plausible Kaholmene core-area marker until raw central geometry and a multi-anchor policy are available.

identity.resolvedIdentity: The dispersed historic fortress destination in Drøbaksundet, with a public visitor core on the Kaholmene and several related historic components.
identity.identityProblem: The name can refer to the visitor core, both Kaholmene or a much wider protected historic landscape. These scopes cannot be represented honestly by one unqualified point.
identity.splitReason: The record may remain one destination if a central core marker and documented secondary anchors are used. Distant components may later justify separate canonical records.

requiredEvidence: raw authoritative or named geometry for the public visitor core
deterministic point derivation for the central historic area
raw geometry for the most important secondary components
explicit policy distinguishing the visitor-core marker from the complete protected landscape
visual QA before any candidate is promoted

evidence.finding: The official page identifies Oscarsborg as the public fortress destination in Drøbaksundet and documents its national historical significance.
evidence.reason: No reusable representation point or visitor-core geometry is exposed in the captured material.

evidence.finding: The official establishment spans several islands and mainland positions, while the central visitor and historic elements are concentrated on the Kaholmene.
evidence.reason: Establishes the need for a core marker plus secondary anchors.

evidence.finding: The protected historic landscape contains more than one hundred objects across islands and mainland areas.
evidence.reason: The legal scope is too broad to use as one gameplay marker or radius.

evidence.sourceName: Named Oscarsborg point and component candidates
evidence.finding: Two generic named points and several named component objects were discovered. They support a multi-anchor model but do not define the central destination marker.
evidence.reason: Raw source data, deterministic geometry and role-specific derivations are missing.

evidence.finding: The legacy point appears spatially plausible for the Kaholmene visitor core but has no stable source identity or derivation.
evidence.reason: Retain temporarily; plausibility alone cannot promote it to verified.

sourceObjectCandidates.rejectionReason: Generic named points with unresolved physical roles.
Important secondary component, not the complete destination.
Distant mainland component outside the island-core radius.

rawEvidence.description: Persisted official identity, spatial-scope and legal-scope findings.
Persisted OSM-derived discovery candidates and explicit source limitations; not raw geometry.

decision.blockedReason: The destination scope is resolved, but raw visitor-core geometry and exact secondary-component geometry have not yet been captured.
decision.nextAction: Capture raw central-area geometry and the relevant secondary-component objects. Then retain or replace the legacy core point using a documented derivation and add secondary anchors without forcing distant components into the island radius.

notes: Canonical coordinates and radius are unchanged, but canonical now exposes needs_manual_map_check metadata.
No generic named point is promoted merely because it contains the fortress name.
The protected legal landscape is too broad to use as a single marker or gameplay circle.
Photo geotags and map-preview points must not be used as production geometry.
